method.label: Maximize a draw below the target

annotationRationale: The method bounds every draw avoiding 15 of one color and exhibits a draw attaining that bound, establishing the minimum guaranteed draw.
sourceMethod: Follows the official maximum-avoiding-draw argument, including why 75 is attainable and 76 is sufficient.

review.mathCheck: Avoiding 15 of any color permits at most \(14+14+14+13+11+9=75\) balls. Those counts are feasible, so 75 fails to guarantee the target, while 76 guarantees it. Choice B is correct.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA 10A Solution 4, printed page 2: maximize the avoiding draw, then add one.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation establishes both the universal bound and its attainability. It is complete and appropriate for AMC 12.
